column3: “Sinful man” replaces flesh of sin; “as an offering” makes an offering explicit.
“Live” supplies a verb where the Greek says being.
“Controlled by the flesh” replaces in the flesh.
“Controlled ... by” replaces in; “Christ” specifies Him in the last clause.
Freedom of glory is recast as “glorious freedom.”
“Bodies” is plural where the Greek has singular body.
“How” replaces “what”; “for us” matches the Textus Receptus (ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν).
